js.oracle.nhin-nhan-lai-tinh-huong-tu.t: Look at the situation again from the opposite angle. What you are denying may be the most important lesson.

js.oracle.nhin-xa-hon-tinh-huong-truoc.t: Look beyond the situation in front of you. You can see what others can’t — use that vision.

js.oracle.nuoc-mem-nhung-thang-da-cung.t: Water is soft yet defeats hard stone. The power of water lies not in force but in persistence and flexibility. Sometimes the best way forward is to give way.

js.oracle.nuoc-sau-khong-song-lon-tri.t: Deep water makes no big waves. True wisdom is often quiet. This is the time to go deep — to study, reflect and explore your inner world rather than perform outwardly.

js.oracle.oracle-khac-tarot-o-diem-nao.t: How is the Oracle different from the Tarot?

js.oracle.que-can-nui-su-dung-lai.t: The Gen trigram — Mountain, stillness and steadfastness. Knowing when to stop is great wisdom. This is a time to pause, not to go further — stay with the present and see clearly before you take the next step.

js.oracle.que-can-troi-duong-thuan-suc.t: The Qian trigram — Heaven, pure Yang, creative power. The energy of leading and creating is strongly present. This is the time to lead the way, initiate and express your strongest will.

js.oracle.que-chan-sam-set-su-thuc.t: The Zhen trigram — Thunder, a sudden awakening. A thunderclap that wakes you. There may be a surprise event, or a realization that suddenly changes how you see things.

js.oracle.que-doai-ho-niem-vui-va.t: The Dui trigram — Lake, joy and communication. The energy of cheerfulness, connection and expression. Shared joy is doubled; shared sorrow is halved — this is a time to connect.

js.oracle.que-kham-nuoc-nguy-hiem-va.t: The Kan trigram — Water, danger and depth. You are passing through deep and dangerous waters. You need wisdom, caution and trust in your ability to get through.

js.oracle.que-khon-dat-am-thuan-su.t: The Kun trigram — Earth, pure Yin, receptivity and nurturing. This is the time to support, serve and nurture what is growing. The strength of Earth lies in its ability to hold and sustain all things.

js.oracle.que-ly-lua-su-sang-to.t: The Li trigram — Fire, clarity and beauty. The light of awareness is shining. Something is being made clear — a truth, an idea or a person shining in your life.

js.oracle.que-ton-gio-su-tham-dan.t: The Xun trigram — Wind, gradual penetration and persistence. Wind doesn’t break through with force but by seeping everywhere with persistence. Your influence is spreading gently and lastingly.

js.oracle.suc-manh-khong-phai-la-chien.t: Strength is not winning on one side — it is the ability to keep balance between opposing forces. You are being called to find your own center again.

js.oracle.thach-thuc-ban-dang-doi-mat.t: The challenge you face is there to control and balance another aspect of your life. Don’t resist — learn from it.

js.oracle.thay-vi-bam-viu-hay-day.t: Instead of clinging or pushing away, observe and fully experience the present moment. This is a lesson in letting go.

js.oracle.thay-vi-doi-dau-truc-tiep.t: Instead of confronting directly, find a more supple way. Flexibility is not weakness — it is wisdom.

js.oracle.thuan-thien-gia-ton-nghich-thi.t: Those who follow Heaven endure; those who oppose Heaven perish — what accords with the way of Heaven survives, what opposes it fades. Don’t resist what is natural and inevitable. Find a way to work with the circumstances, not against them.

js.oracle.thuy-sinh-moc-moc-sinh-hoa.t: Water nourishes Wood, Wood feeds Fire... Mutual support is the nature of the universe. You are receiving support from others, or being called to become a source of nourishment for someone.

js.oracle.tim-hieu-van-khi-nam-nay.t: Look into your fortune for this year. Act in accord with the times and don’t resist the flow of destiny.

js.oracle.tin-tuong-vao-qua-trinh-nhung.t: Trust the process. Your quiet efforts are accumulating. Don’t give up just because you can’t see results right away.

js.oracle.tri-nhan-gia-tri-tu-tri.t: He who knows others is wise; he who knows himself is enlightened — knowing others is knowledge, knowing yourself is insight. The highest understanding is understanding yourself — your strengths, weaknesses, motivations and true fears.

js.oracle.tri-tuc-biet-du-thi-thuong.t: Contentment — those who know when they have enough are usually happy. The one with the most is not the happiest. The one who cherishes what they have is truly rich.

js.oracle.tu-thai-cuc-sinh-luong-nghi.t: From the Taiji arise the Two Modes — from one comes two, and then all things. You stand at the beginning of a new cycle. All potential rests in stillness, waiting for the moment to ripen.

js.oracle.van-luu-nien-van-khi-cua.t: Annual flow — the fortune of the current year strongly affects every decision. Consider the overall course of your luck before acting. Going with the flow is the wisest choice.

js.oracle.van-vat-deu-vo-thuong-khong.t: All things are impermanent — nothing lasts forever, neither pain nor happiness. What is hurting you will pass; what delights you will change too. Live fully in this moment.

js.oracle.van-vat-ton-tai-trong-su.t: All things exist in harmonious opposition. What you think of as dark holds a seed of light; what shines brightly carries the core of darkness within it. Don’t resist opposition — find balance within it.

js.oracle.vo-vi-nhi-vo-bat-vi.t: Wu wei er wu bu wei — do nothing, yet nothing is left undone. Act naturally, without forcing, in accord with the natural way of things. This is the highest kind of strength.

js.oracle.xem-xet-dau-la-nhung-dieu.t: Consider where your life is out of balance. Work/rest, giving/receiving, action/reflection — readjust.

js.shellui.kmx-chu-ban.t: The chart is drawn by the Luo Shu with South at the top — the classical way, the reverse of an ordinary map. Each cell: gate (large line) · heaven-plate star and deity · heaven-plate stem (bold) over earth-plate stem (italic). #n is the relative rank among the nine palaces, not a verdict of fortune.

js.shellui.kmx-chu-bang.t: The Engine column is the good/bad verdict of the classical algorithm. The Score column is a relative rank computed by the page so that it can always point to the best direction — formula: auspicious gate +3 / inauspicious −3, star and deity ±2, Three Marvels +2, +1 per auspicious pattern and −1 per inauspicious pattern. Measured over 366 charts across a year, only 26.5% of charts have a palace the engine rates auspicious, so reading the Engine column alone, the chart says "everywhere is bad" most of the time.

luangiai.tu-vi-dau-so-la-mot.t: Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star Astrology) is a traditional system of Chinese destiny reading. It casts a chart from the lunar birth hour, with 12 palaces and a system of major and minor stars. Refined over many generations, it became popular in Vietnam through the translation of Zi Wei Dou Shu Xin Bian (Tử Vi Đẩu Số Tân Biên) by Vân Đằng Thái Thứ Lang, and grew into a distinct Vietnamese school.
